behavioralGroups.title: Rate-limit login attempts
behavioralGroups.description: Adds a sliding-window limiter around the login handler.

annotations.summary: Rejects further attempts once the sliding window limit is hit.

evidence.description: MAX_ATTEMPTS is read from config, defaulting to 5.

verification.description: Confirm the limiter resets after the window elapses.

answers.body: The window is 60 seconds, configured via RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS.
